out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED A CUP IN THE HANDWASHING SINK AT THE TORTILLA STATION AND A SCOOP IN THE HANDWASHING SINK BY THE COLD PREP.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE SINKS AND PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED PEPPERS AT 47F (3HR), CORN SALSA AT 47F (3HR), AND MOZZARELLA AT ~50F (3HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: FOOD TO BE DISPOSED OF IN ONE HOUR. PIC WILL NOT USE COOLER UNTIL IT IS TURNED DOWN OR RELOCATED.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 165F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 165F for a stationary rack single temperature machine. THE THERMALPLATE REACHED 157F. RAN THE DISHMACHINE THREE TIMES
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F.. ECOLAB RAN THE DISHMACHINE AND OBSERVED 166F.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure:TENDERIZED STEAK THAT IS SERVED UNDERCOOKED ARE NOT PROPERLY DISCLOSED ON THE MENU.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients.PLACE ASTERISK RIGHT BY THE STEAK FOR EACH FOOD ITEM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: OBSERVED THE FOLLOWING NON-NSF EQUIPMENTS: CROCKPOTS, FRIDGID AIR FREEZER, CUISINART FOOD PROCESSOR, AND BEAN DRILL
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. STOP USING THESE ITEMS AND OBTAIN FOOD EQUIPMENT WITH NSF CERTIFICATIONS

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine. OBSERVED HEAT INDICATOR FOR 180F
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature.OBTAIN ONE FOR 160F

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. INDIVIDUAL BACKFLOW DEVICE IS NEEDED FOR THE ICE MAKER
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14.. PROVIDE A BACKFLOW PREVENTER

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outdoor Storage Surface, Nonabsorbent, Sloped
violations.observation: The waste oil container is stored on absorbent material.OIL BARREL IS STORED ON MULCH
violations.corrective_action: An outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and shall be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain.OBTAINS NONABSORBENT MATERIAL SUCH AS CONCRETE OR ASPHALT SLAB LARGE ENOUGH FOR THE GREASE BARREL.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: EHS observed employee scooping ice from server well ice bin using a cup they were holding with there bare hands.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. PIC STOPPED EMPLOYEE AND REVIEWED WITH EMPLOYEE BARE HAND CONTACT WITH RTE FOOD AND HAD EMPLOYEE SCOOP THE ICE USING AND APPROVED SCOOP WITH A HANDLE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink next to the mechanical warewashing machine and 3 compartment sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Employee replaced the paper towels at handwashing sink next to mechanical warewashing machine during inspection.

violations.title: Hot Holding

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED RAID IN THE FACILITY DURING THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS HAD PIC DISPOSE OF THE RAID.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: ROP, HACCP Plan in Place
violations.observation: The establishment does not have an approved HACCP plan for the food that is packaged using the Reduced Oxygen Packaging (ROP) process. OBSERVED A REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGING HACCP PROCESS OCCURRING IN THE FACILITY, AFTER HEALTH DEPARTMENT. HAS RECEIVED CONFIRMATION FROM CORPORATE REPRESENTATIVE THAT HACCP COOK CHILL PROCESS HAS BEEN PHASED OUT .
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment that packages a time/temperature control for safe food using a Reduced Oxygen Packaging method shall have a HACCP plan that contains the information specified under 8-201.14(D) and that: 1) identifies the food to be packaged, 2) requires that the packaged food shall be maintained at 41F or less, has a water activity of 0.91 or less, a pH of 4.6 or less, is a meat or poultry product that is cured at a food processing plant, is received in an intact package, or is a food with a high level of competing organisms, 3) describes how the package shall be prominently and conspicuosly labeled on the principal display panel in bold type on a contrasting background with instructions to maintain the food at 41F or below and discard the food if within 14 calendar days of its packaging, 40 limits the refrigerated shelf life to no more than 14 calendar days from packaging to consumption or the origjnal manufacturer's 'sell by' or 'use by' date whichever occurs first, 5) includes operational procedures that prohibit contacting food with bare hands, identifies a designated work area and the method by which physical barriers or methods of separation minimizes cross contamination, access to the processing equipment is limited to responsible trained personnel, and cleaning and sanitizing procedures for equipment/utensils is monitored, and 6) describes the training program that ensures that the individual responsible for the ROP operation understands the concepts required for a safe operation, understands the equipment and facilites, and procedures specified in this section. EHS INFORMED PIC ABOUT CONFIRMATION FROM CORPORATE THAT HACCP COOK CHILL PROCESS HAS BEEN PHASED OUT. PIC STOPPED COOK CHILL PROCESSING UNTIL FURTHER INFORMATION FROM CORPORATE REPRESENTATIVE HAS BEEN RECEIVED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no paper towels at the HANDSINK in the dish washing area and the HANDSINK next to the unused Alto SHAAM.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CFM replaced paper towels at both hand sinks.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no hand soap at the HANDSINK in the dish washing area and the HANDSINK next to the unused Alto SHAAM.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CFM refilled hand soap at each sink.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located in the server station across from expo line is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. Observed cardboard over sink basin and water turned off at hand sink located in the server station across from the expo line.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CFM removed cardboard and will turn water on at hand sink. EHS explained that all hand sinks, regardless of frequency of use, must remain accessible for hand washing with hand soap and paper towels available and hot water able to reach 100F.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in TWO SEPARATE SANITIZER BUCKETS AT THE COOKLINE with a concentration of 0 - ZERO- ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. CFM PREPARED FRESH SANITIZER BUCKETS - QUATERNARY AMMONIUM WAS OBSERVED AT 200-400PPM.
